about: flybrain_models.escape_benchmark output; regenerate with `uv run python -m flybrain_models.escape_benchmark`

key_numbers_doc.models: connectome = shipped EscapeCircuit; rewired / random = mean over 5 / 3 control seeds with the connectome's scalars; no_interneurons = interneurons removed, connectome scalars; proximity_threshold and looming_rate_threshold = baselines (one fitted threshold each)
key_numbers_doc.sim_hit_rate: fraction of simulated threats (>= 0.3 m/s to contact) with a trigger within -0.1..+1.0 s of the hand entering sensor range
key_numbers_doc.sim_fa_per_min: triggers that are not hits, per minute of scored non-threat time
key_numbers_doc.sim_latency_ms: mean trigger time after the hand enters range (D_FAR = 12 cm)
key_numbers_doc.sim_side_correct: fraction of lateral hits with the correct side (shipped readout: LC4+LPLC2 left/right activity)
key_numbers_doc.sim_side_correct_gf_readout: same, if the side were read from GF left vs right (the wiring-dependent readout)
key_numbers_doc.sim_fa_per_min_noisy: false alarms per minute with sensor noise sd 80
key_numbers_doc.sim_fa_per_min_{drift,hover,stop_short}: false alarms per minute in those non-threat episodes
key_numbers_doc.sim_trigger_distance_cm_{fast,slow}: hand distance at trigger, 0.8-1.6 m/s and 0.3-0.5 m/s approaches
key_numbers_doc.sim_hit_rate_{left,right,head_on}: hit rate for approaches from the left, right and head-on (both channels see the hand)
key_numbers_doc.sim_hit_rate_{left,right}_only: hit rate when only that side's channel ever sees the hand (the far channel stays at baseline), as seen on the robot
key_numbers_doc.robot_hits_of_9: approaches with a trigger in the 45 s robot escape run (runs/escape-20261111-183054, offline rule; 9 approach events)
key_numbers_doc.robot_hits_{left,right}: same, split by the channel that saw the hand first (left = pin 36; robot run: 2 left events, both seen by pin 36 only, 6 right, and 1 that both channels saw at once, counted in neither)
key_numbers_doc.robot_latency_ms: mean trigger time after labelled onset, robot run
key_numbers_doc.robot_false_alarms: triggers outside approach events, robot run
key_numbers_doc.real_hits_of_5: recorded approaches (offline rule) with a trigger
key_numbers_doc.real_latency_ms: mean trigger time after the labelled onset (first sample < 3100) on the recording
key_numbers_doc.real_false_alarms: triggers outside the five labelled events (25 s)
key_numbers_doc.gf_ipsilateral_fraction: fraction of direct LC4+LPLC2 -> GF synapses that come from the GF's own side (wiring, not behaviour)
key_numbers_doc.gf_lc4_to_lplc2_ratio: direct LC4 -> GF over LPLC2 -> GF synapses

protocols.sensor: simulated raw = 3400 * clip((d - 5 cm) / 7 cm, 0, 1) + noise
protocols.ground_truth: threat = approach >= 0.3 m/s to within 5 cm; non-threats: stop short inside the band, slow drift <= 0.08 m/s, hover with tremor, moving away, empty; 0.15-0.3 m/s ambiguous (speed curve only)
protocols.recording_labels: offline rule: event onset = first sample with min(raw) < 3100 after >= 0.5 s quiet; approach if min(raw) < 500 within 0.5 s; event ends when both channels >= 3100; leading side = channel first below 1700. pin36 assumed left (not established)
